author: Elastic
rule.description:
Detects when a GitHub Actions workflow run is deleted within 30 minutes of its creation. Adversaries who abuse Actions
for execution or secret theft may delete short-lived runs afterward to remove job logs that show the malicious steps.
false_positives:
Automation that deletes failed or temporary workflow runs shortly after execution. Review whether the workflow,
    repository, and actors are expected.
rule.name: GitHub Actions Workflow Run Rapidly Deleted
rule.note:
## Triage and analysis

### Investigating GitHub Actions Workflow Run Rapidly Deleted

`workflows.delete_workflow_run` is recorded when a run is deleted. GitHub does not always emit a separate audit event for deleting only the logs; the run deletion itself is the reliable cover-up signal. This rule correlates workflow-run creation and deletion events for the same organization, repository, and workflow when they occur within 30 minutes.

### Possible investigation steps

- Review `user.name`, `github.repo`, `github.data.workflow_id`, and the correlated creation and deletion timestamps.
- Determine which workflow file ran and whether it was recently added or modified.
- Look for `git.push` by `github-actions[bot]` or unexpected `GITHUB_TOKEN` usage around the same time.
- Check org/repo secrets access (`api.request` for secrets) from the same actor.

### False positive analysis

- Admins pruning old CI history.
- Tools that delete runs after collecting artifacts.

### Response and remediation

- If unauthorized, disable the suspect workflow and rotate secrets used by Actions.
- Review commits to `.github/workflows/` and restrict `GITHUB_TOKEN` permissions.
- Preserve remaining Actions logs and audit events for the incident window.
rule.query:
FROM logs-github.audit-*
| WHERE event.module == "github" AND data_stream.dataset == "github.audit"
    AND event.action IN (
      "workflows.created_workflow_run",
      "workflows.delete_workflow_run"
    )
| EVAL
    Esql.is_workflow_run_created = event.action == "workflows.created_workflow_run",
    Esql.is_workflow_run_deleted = event.action == "workflows.delete_workflow_run"
| STATS
    Esql.workflow_run_created_count = SUM(CASE(Esql.is_workflow_run_created, 1, 0)),
    Esql.workflow_run_deleted_count = SUM(CASE(Esql.is_workflow_run_deleted, 1, 0)),
    Esql.workflow_run_created_at = MIN(CASE(Esql.is_workflow_run_created, @timestamp, null)),
    Esql.workflow_run_deleted_at = MAX(CASE(Esql.is_workflow_run_deleted, @timestamp, null)),
    user.name = VALUES(user.name),
    github.actor_ip = VALUES(github.actor_ip),
    github.hashed_token = VALUES(github.hashed_token),
    github.programmatic_access_type = VALUES(github.programmatic_access_type),
    github.user_agent = VALUES(github.user_agent),
    github.data.workflow_run_id = VALUES(github.data.workflow_run_id)
  BY github.org, github.repo, github.data.workflow_id
| EVAL Esql.time_diff_seconds = DATE_DIFF(
    "second", Esql.workflow_run_created_at, Esql.workflow_run_deleted_at
  )
| WHERE Esql.workflow_run_created_count > 0
    AND Esql.workflow_run_deleted_count > 0
    AND Esql.time_diff_seconds >= 0
    AND Esql.time_diff_seconds <= 1800
    AND DATE_DIFF("minute", Esql.workflow_run_deleted_at, NOW()) <= 10
| KEEP
    Esql.workflow_run_created_at,
    Esql.workflow_run_deleted_at,
    Esql.time_diff_seconds,
    Esql.workflow_run_created_count,
    Esql.workflow_run_deleted_count,
    user.name,
    github.org,
    github.repo,
    github.actor_ip,
    github.hashed_token,
    github.programmatic_access_type,
    github.user_agent,
    github.data.workflow_id,
    github.data.workflow_run_id
